# FLX-2101: the bundle's inputDigest has moved since the plan was recorded

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC section 11: apply/run refuse to proceed once a document the plan covered has changed on disk, an in-bundle FLUID contract has changed, or a document was added or removed. Re-run `fluxsim plan` against the bundle as it stands now, review the new plan, then apply it -- an apply is a decision about the bundle the plan describes, not about whatever the bundle happens to be by the time apply runs.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2101
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
